note: 固定研究问题与固定拆分（research.fixed_plan）：两组（serial / parallel）共用同一份清单；每题 3 个子主题，各 8 次工具份额（task 级共 30 次）。拆分由维护者按 deep-research skill 的格式事先写定（见 README 的“偏差”）。

questions.text: 比较钠离子电池与磷酸铁锂电池在电网储能中的现状：成本、循环寿命与安全性，以及 2024–2025 年的量产进展。

fixed_plan.title: 成本与材料
fixed_plan.brief: 两种电池的电芯与系统成本（元/Wh 或 USD/kWh）及其材料来源差异，引用 2024–2025 年的公开数据。

fixed_plan.title: 循环寿命与安全性
fixed_plan.brief: 循环寿命、低温性能与热失控风险的对比，优先厂商规格书与测试报告。

fixed_plan.title: 量产与项目进展
fixed_plan.brief: 2024–2025 年钠离子电池的量产线与已投运的储能项目（宁德时代、中科海钠等）。

questions.text: How do the EU AI Act's obligations for general-purpose AI models work, when do they apply, and how are providers preparing to comply?

fixed_plan.title: GPAI obligations
fixed_plan.brief: What the AI Act requires of general-purpose AI model providers, including the systemic-risk tier (Articles 53 and 55).

fixed_plan.title: Timeline and enforcement
fixed_plan.brief: Application dates, the AI Office's role, penalties, and grandfathering for models already on the market.

fixed_plan.title: Code of practice and industry response
fixed_plan.brief: The GPAI code of practice and which major providers have signed or criticised it.

questions.text: 数据中心液冷技术（冷板式与浸没式）的能效、成本与 2024–2025 年在中国的部署情况如何？

fixed_plan.title: 技术路线与能效
fixed_plan.brief: 冷板式与单相/两相浸没式的原理、PUE 与适用功率密度。

fixed_plan.title: 成本与改造难度
fixed_plan.brief: 初投资、运维成本与对既有机房改造的要求，引用厂商或研究机构数据。

fixed_plan.title: 中国部署案例
fixed_plan.brief: 2024–2025 年国内运营商与互联网公司的液冷部署规模和政策要求。

questions.text: What is the state of small modular reactors (SMRs) in 2025: leading designs, licensing status, and the main cost and schedule risks?

fixed_plan.title: Leading SMR designs
fixed_plan.brief: The most advanced designs (e.g. NuScale, BWRX-300, Rolls-Royce SMR, ACP100) and their key parameters.

fixed_plan.title: Licensing and first projects
fixed_plan.brief: Regulatory approvals and first-of-a-kind projects in the US, Canada, UK and China as of 2025.

fixed_plan.title: Cost and schedule risks
fixed_plan.brief: Evidence on cost overruns and cancellations (e.g. the UAMPS cancellation) and estimated levelised costs.

questions.text: 开源大模型的主要许可证（Llama 社区许可、Apache 2.0、Qwen 许可等）在商用限制上有哪些差异？

fixed_plan.title: Llama 社区许可
fixed_plan.brief: 月活阈值、可接受使用政策与衍生模型命名要求。

fixed_plan.title: Apache 2.0 与 MIT 类模型
fixed_plan.brief: 以 Apache 2.0 或 MIT 发布的主流模型（Mistral、DeepSeek 等）及其权利与义务。

fixed_plan.title: Qwen 与其他自定义许可
fixed_plan.brief: Qwen、Gemma 等自定义许可的商用条件与限制条款。

questions.text: How effective are GLP-1 receptor agonists such as semaglutide and tirzepatide for weight loss, what are their main side effects, and how has access and pricing changed?

fixed_plan.title: Efficacy in trials
fixed_plan.brief: Average weight loss in the key phase 3 trials (STEP, SURMOUNT) and head-to-head results.

fixed_plan.title: Side effects and safety
fixed_plan.brief: Common gastrointestinal effects, discontinuation rates, and safety signals under investigation.

fixed_plan.title: Access, supply and pricing
fixed_plan.brief: List prices, shortages, compounded versions and insurance coverage changes in 2024–2025.

questions.text: 欧洲主要国家（德国、法国、英国）的住宅热泵补贴政策在 2025 年有何不同？

fixed_plan.title: 德国
fixed_plan.brief: BEG 补贴的比例、上限与收入加成，以及 2024 年供暖法修订的影响。

fixed_plan.title: 法国
fixed_plan.brief: MaPrimeRénov' 对热泵的补贴额度与 2025 年调整。

fixed_plan.title: 英国
fixed_plan.brief: Boiler Upgrade Scheme 的补贴金额、申请量与 2025 年变化。

questions.text: What are the main approaches to post-quantum cryptography migration, which NIST standards were finalised, and what deadlines do governments set?

fixed_plan.title: NIST PQC standards
fixed_plan.brief: FIPS 203, 204 and 205: algorithms, parameters and intended uses.

fixed_plan.title: Migration approaches
fixed_plan.brief: Hybrid key exchange in TLS, crypto-agility and inventory practices, with deployment examples.

fixed_plan.title: Government deadlines
fixed_plan.brief: Timelines from the US (NSM-10, CNSA 2.0), the UK NCSC and the EU.

questions.text: 固态电池的产业化进展如何？请比较硫化物、氧化物与聚合物路线以及主要企业的量产时间表。

fixed_plan.title: 技术路线对比
fixed_plan.brief: 硫化物、氧化物、聚合物电解质的离子电导率、界面问题与成本。

fixed_plan.title: 主要企业与时间表
fixed_plan.brief: 丰田、宁德时代、QuantumScape、卫蓝新能源等的量产计划与样品进展。

fixed_plan.title: 半固态电池装车情况
fixed_plan.brief: 2024–2025 年半固态电池在量产车型上的应用与能量密度。

questions.text: How are major cloud providers pricing and supplying AI accelerators in 2025 (Nvidia H100/H200/B200, TPU, Trainium), and what constrains supply?

fixed_plan.title: Cloud GPU pricing
fixed_plan.brief: On-demand and reserved hourly prices for H100/H200/B200 instances on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud.

fixed_plan.title: Custom accelerators
fixed_plan.brief: Google TPU and AWS Trainium generations, availability and claimed price-performance.

fixed_plan.title: Supply constraints
fixed_plan.brief: CoWoS packaging capacity, HBM supply and export controls affecting availability.
